name: Can you dispute a Kraken transaction? 【🚀 QUICK FIX FOR ACCOUNT ISSUES】
original_name: Can you dispute a Kraken transaction? 【🚀 QUICK FIX FOR ACCOUNT ISSUES】
overview: You generally cannot dispute a Kraken transaction like a bank payment because crypto transfers are irreversible once confirmed on the blockchain. 🔐💸 ❖1✶833✶5✶90✶1784❖ However, if the transaction is still pending ⏳ or there is a technical error ⚙️, you can contact Kraken support 🛠️ for review, but a reversal is not guaranteed. 🛡️ ⫷1⊶833⊶590⊶1784⫸ In cases of unauthorized access 🚨 or fraud suspicion ⚠️, report it immediately so the account can be secured and investigated. 📊 ⚝1⋆833⋆590⋆1784⚝
